FN-QKQ2415-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 67
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, & Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/05/2025
Senate Bill 67 as introduced would remove the authority of the Alabama State Board of
Veterans Affairs to oversee the Department of Veterans Affairs, including appointing the
Commissioner of the Department and approving all actions and expenditures related to the State
Veterans Homes and the state veterans’ cemeteries. This bill would make the Commissioner of
Veterans Affairs a cabinet position, where the Commissioner’s salary would be set by the
Governor without the recommendation of the State Personnel Board. This could increase or
decrease the financial obligations of department funds by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the difference in the salary set by the Governor and the salary currently set for the
Commissioner by the board.
Finally, this bill would change the composition of the State Board of Veterans Affairs from a
12-member board overseeing the operations of the department to a 9-member advisory board,
which could increase or decrease the obligations of department funds by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the per diem rate fixed by the Commissioner and the travel expenses
incurred by board members to attend meetings of the board.

FN-QKQ2415-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 67
Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/21/2025
Senate Bill 67 as passed the Senate could increase or decrease the obligations of the Department
of Veterans Affairs by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in: (1) the salary
of the commissioner of the department set by the Alabama State Board of Veterans Affairs, as
provided by current law; and, (2) the salary set by the Governor, as provided by this bill.
This bill would also transfer certain powers and duties related to oversight of the department and
its programs from the board to the commissioner.
